title: Playboy August 1988 Kimberley Conrad Cover Hefner Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Readable vintage copy with cover wear: patches of white surface scuffing/peeling on the front cover near the barcode and pocket square, and on the back cover along the top edge (see photos 1-3). No tears; spine intact. Complete with centerfold. Priced for condition. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, August 1988 issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover girl Kimberley Conrad - the new woman in Hef's life. Also: The Great Palimony Caper; Gorbachev: The Great Red Hope? by Robert Scheer.

Back cover: Vantage Ultra Lights ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
